notes: Generated by evaluating SETTINGS_SCHEMA; do not edit by hand.
importGraph hashes the transitive local imports; external packages follow the lockfile.

ui.label: Auto Resume
ui.description: Automatically resume the most recent session in the current directory

ui.label: Sleep Prevention
ui.description: Prevent macOS sleep during active sessions. Each level is cumulative — it adds the flags of all lower levels.

ui.label: Enable Advisor
ui.description: Pair a second model (assigned to the 'advisor' role) that passively reviews each turn and injects notes.

ui.label: Enable Prewalk
ui.description: Start on the active model, then switch to a fast/cheap model (default the 'smol' role) at the first edit/write after the plan nudge's todo list exists — the strong model plans, commits the todos, and starts the implementation before handing off. Overridable per session with --prewalk / --no-prewalk.

ui.label: Advisor Sync Backlog
ui.description: Pause the main agent for up to 30 seconds if the advisor falls behind by this many turns. Off disables catch-up delays.

ui.label: Advisor Immune Turns
ui.description: After an advisor concern or blocker interrupts, route further concerns/blockers non-interruptingly for this many primary turns.

ui.label: Enable Git Integration
ui.description: Show git branch, status, and PR information in the TUI and watch repository metadata.

ui.label: Max In-Flight Requests
ui.description: Maximum concurrent LLM requests per provider id (for example "openai" or "anthropic"), shared across local OMP processes with this config root. Omitted providers are unlimited.

ui.label: Codex Code Mode
ui.description: Route Codex code_mode_only models (GPT-5.6) through eval. The direct tools are eval, ask, todo, yield, think, checkpoint, and rewind. Use eval cells for other session tools. Mirrors codex-rs Code Mode. 'auto' follows the model catalog flag.

ui.label: Codex Code Mode Direct Tools
ui.description: Extra direct tools for Codex Code Mode. The standard direct tools are eval, ask, todo, yield, think, checkpoint, and rewind.

ui.label: Model Role Storage
ui.description: Where model selector role assignments are saved

ui.label: Dark Theme
ui.description: Theme used when the terminal has a dark background

ui.label: Light Theme
ui.description: Theme used when the terminal has a light background

ui.label: Symbol Preset
ui.description: Glyph set for icons and symbols (Unicode, Nerd Font, or ASCII)

ui.label: Color-Blind Mode
ui.description: Use blue instead of green for diff additions

ui.label: Composer Shape
ui.description: Visual layout of the input editor and status line

ui.label: Status Line Preset
ui.description: Pre-built status line configurations

ui.label: Status Line Separator
ui.description: Style of separators between segments

ui.label: Context-Reactive Line
ui.description: How the line between the left and right segments reflects context usage (box composer only)

ui.label: Session Accent
ui.description: Use the session name color for the editor border and status line gap

ui.label: Transparent Status Line
ui.description: Use the terminal's default background for the status line instead of the theme's `statusLineBg`. Powerline end caps are dropped because they need a contrasting fill to bridge into the surrounding terminal.

ui.label: Compact Thinking Level
ui.description: Show the thinking level as a single icon on the model name instead of a separate ` · <level>` suffix.

ui.label: Artifact Spill Threshold (KB)
ui.description: Tool output above this size is saved as an artifact; tail is kept inline

ui.label: Artifact Tail Size (KB)
ui.description: Amount of tail content kept inline when output spills to artifact

ui.label: Artifact Head Size (KB)
ui.description: Amount of head content kept inline alongside the tail when output spills to artifact (middle elision). 0 disables — keep tail only.

ui.label: Output Column Cap
ui.description: Per-line byte cap for streaming tool outputs (bash, python, js eval) and `read`. Lines wider than this are ellipsis-truncated; remaining bytes up to the next newline are dropped. 0 disables.

ui.label: Artifact Tail Lines
ui.description: Maximum lines of tail content kept inline when output spills to artifact

ui.label: Show Hook Status
ui.description: Display hook status messages below the status line

ui.label: Show Inline Images
ui.description: Render images inline in the terminal

ui.label: Auto-Resize Images
ui.description: Resize large images to 2000x2000 max for better model compatibility

ui.label: Block Images
ui.description: Prevent images from being sent to LLM providers

ui.label: Describe Images for Text Models
ui.description: When an image is attached to a model without vision support, save it under local:// and inject a description from a vision-capable model instead of dropping it

ui.label: Serve Images as URLs
ui.description: Publish outgoing images through the configured backend chain and send URL-fetching providers short URLs instead of inline base64. Falls back to inline automatically when every backend or a provider fetch fails

ui.label: Image URL Backends
ui.description: Ordered destinations tried when publishing images for provider access

ui.label: Image Upload Command
ui.description: Argv template for the command backend; {file} is the image path, {mime}/{ext} optional. The last URL printed on stdout is used (e.g. pasta -b -f {file})

ui.label: Image URL Public Base
ui.description: Externally reachable base URL fronting the blob server (required for ssh, optional for direct)

ui.label: Image URL Lifetime (hours)
ui.description: Serving window for locally hosted image URLs, measured from the last time a conversation sent them; resuming a conversation re-arms the window at the same link. 0 keeps links alive while the broker runs

ui.label: Image URL Bind Host
ui.description: Host the blob server binds to; loopback for tunnels, 0.0.0.0 for direct serving

ui.label: Image URL SSH Target
ui.description: user@host destination for the ssh reverse forward

ui.label: Image URL SSH Remote Port
ui.description: Remote listen port of the ssh reverse forward that your web server proxies to

ui.label: Resize Scrollback
ui.description: How a settled terminal resize refreshes transcript rows retained in terminal scrollback

ui.label: Native Terminal Progress
ui.description: Emit OSC 9;4 indeterminate progress while the agent or context maintenance is running

ui.label: Large Headings (Kitty)
ui.description: Render Markdown H1 headings at 2x scale using Kitty's OSC 66 text-sizing protocol. Only takes effect on Kitty terminals; ignored everywhere else. Off by default.

ui.label: Render Mermaid Diagrams
ui.description: Render Mermaid fenced code blocks as ASCII diagrams

ui.label: Codex Reset Fireworks
ui.description: Celebrate unscheduled Codex weekly usage resets and newly banked saved resets with a top-third fireworks overlay that remains until Escape

ui.label: Terminal Title Run State
ui.description: Show the agent run state in the terminal title's separator — an animated spinner while working (a static ':' on Windows), '>' when it's your turn, '!' when the agent is waiting on you

ui.label: Terminal Hyperlinks
ui.description: Wrap paths and URLs in OSC 8 hyperlinks for terminal-native click-to-open (auto: detect support; off: never; always: unconditional)

ui.label: Tight Layout
ui.description: Remove the 1-character horizontal padding from the left and right of the terminal output

ui.label: Shimmer
ui.description: Animation style for working/loading messages

ui.label: Smooth Streaming
ui.description: Reveal assistant text and streamed tool input smoothly while chunks arrive

ui.label: Hide Tool Activity
ui.description: Hide model-initiated tool calls and results from the transcript

ui.label: Show Token Usage
ui.description: Show per-turn token usage on assistant messages

ui.label: Show Turn Time
ui.description: Show the total prompt-to-yield time (including tool calls) on assistant message usage rows

ui.label: Cache Miss Marker
ui.description: Show a divider after an assistant turn whose request lost (missed) the prompt cache

ui.label: Collapse Compacted History
ui.description: Collapse pre-compaction history behind the summary divider on the live transcript; disable to keep the full transcript inline with dividers at each compaction point

ui.label: Show Hardware Cursor
ui.description: Show terminal cursor for IME support

ui.label: IME-Safe Prompt Layout
ui.description: Move the prompt's bottom border to a separate row so macOS IME preedit cannot displace it

ui.label: Thinking Level
ui.description: Reasoning depth for thinking-capable models

ui.label: Hide Thinking Blocks
ui.description: Hide thinking blocks in assistant responses

ui.label: Prose Only Thinking
ui.description: Omit code blocks from thinking summaries and replace them with an ellipsis

ui.label: Omit Thinking summaries
ui.description: Instruct upstream providers to completely omit thinking summaries from responses (where supported)

ui.label: External Thinking
ui.description: Private scratchpad; not shown to user. Disables supported GPT, Claude, and Gemini reasoning

ui.label: Loop Guard
ui.description: Enable automatic stream loop detection for model reasoning and prose

ui.label: Loop Guard Scan Prose
ui.description: Apply loop guard to assistant prose messages in addition to thinking logs

ui.label: Loop Guard Tool-Call Reminder
ui.description: When a Gemini reasoning stream emits many consecutive planning headers without calling a tool, interrupt it and inject a reminder to issue a tool call (requires Loop Guard)

ui.label: Tool-Call Loop Guard
ui.description: Detect consecutive identical tool calls across turns and inject a corrective steer

ui.label: Tool-Call Loop Threshold
ui.description: Consecutive identical tool calls required before the corrective steer is injected

ui.label: Tool-Call Loop Exempt Tools
ui.description: Tool names that may repeat consecutively without triggering the cross-turn loop guard

ui.label: Inline Tool Descriptors
ui.description: Render full tool descriptors in the system prompt and strip top-level/nested descriptions from provider tool schemas so descriptor text is sent once. Auto enables this for Gemini models and disables it otherwise

ui.label: Include Model in Prompt
ui.description: Surface the active model identifier in the system prompt so the agent knows which model it is

ui.label: Include Workspace Tree
ui.description: Render the workspace directory tree in the system prompt. WARNING: This can bust prompt caching across sessions when files are modified.

ui.label: Additional Workspace Dirs
ui.description: Extra workspace directories added to every session as additional roots (multi-root workspace). Managed live via /add-dir and /remove-dir. Paths resolve relative to cwd; absolute paths recommended. The agent is told these roots exist and can read/grep/glob them.

ui.label: Personality
ui.description: Communication style rendered into the system prompt's personality block

ui.label: Temperature
ui.description: Sampling temperature (0 = deterministic, 1 = creative, -1 = provider default)

ui.label: Top P
ui.description: Nucleus sampling cutoff (0-1, -1 = provider default)

ui.label: Top K
ui.description: Sample from top-K tokens (-1 = provider default)

ui.label: Min P
ui.description: Minimum probability threshold (0-1, -1 = provider default)

ui.label: Presence Penalty
ui.description: Penalty for introducing already-present tokens (-1 = provider default)

ui.label: Repetition Penalty
ui.description: Penalty for repeated tokens (-1 = provider default)

ui.label: Text Verbosity
ui.description: OpenAI Responses and Codex response verbosity (low, medium, or high)

ui.label: Service Tier — OpenAI
ui.description: Processing tier for OpenAI / OpenAI-Codex requests, and OpenAI-family models routed via OpenRouter (none = omit). Sent as `service_tier`.

ui.label: Service Tier — Anthropic
ui.description: Processing tier for Claude requests. `priority` realizes fast mode (`speed: "fast"`) on supported direct Anthropic models; ignored on Bedrock/Vertex Claude and via OpenRouter.

ui.label: Service Tier — Google
ui.description: Processing tier for Gemini (Google AI Studio + Vertex) requests, and Google-family models routed via OpenRouter (none = omit). Sent as the top-level `serviceTier` field.

ui.label: Service Tier — Subagent
ui.description: Service Tier for spawned task/eval subagents. Inherit = match the main agent's live per-family tiers (tracks /fast); pick a value to apply it to whichever family the subagent's model belongs to.

ui.label: Service Tier — Advisor
ui.description: Service Tier for the advisor model. None = standard processing; Inherit = match the main agent's live per-family tiers; pick a value to apply it to the advisor model's family.

ui.label: Retry Attempts
ui.description: Maximum retry attempts on API errors

ui.label: Max Retry Delay
ui.description: Maximum wait between retries, in ms. When the provider asks us to wait longer than this and no credential or model fallback succeeds, the request fails fast instead of sleeping (e.g. 3-hour Anthropic rate-limit windows). 0 disables the ceiling — to let the session auto-resume through provider-stated quota resets.

ui.label: Retry Model Fallback
ui.description: Allow retry recovery to switch to configured fallback models

ui.label: Usage-Aware Fallback
ui.description: Use reliable coding-plan quota reports to prefer same-provider accounts, then configured fallback models, before a hard usage limit. Ordinary configured API keys are excluded.

ui.label: Reserve Margin
ui.description: Treat a coding-plan model as near its limit below this remaining percentage. Unknown or unmapped usage keeps the primary model.

ui.label: Reserve Policy
ui.description: What to do when every same-provider coding-plan account is inside the reserve margin.

ui.label: Retry Fallback Chains
ui.description: JSON object mapping model roles, model selectors ("provider/model-id"), or provider wildcards ("provider/*") to ordered fallback selectors, e.g. {"default":["openai/gpt-4o-mini"],"google-antigravity/*":["google/*","google-vertex/*"]}. Model-oriented keys apply whenever that model/provider is active, regardless of role; a "provider/*" entry keeps the failing model's id and swaps the provider. An id-prefixed wildcard ("openrouter/google/*") re-prefixes the failing model's bare id (google-antigravity/gemini-x -> openrouter/google/gemini-x) and, used as a key, matches only that provider's ids under the prefix.

ui.label: Fallback Revert Policy
ui.description: When to return to the primary model after a fallback

ui.label: Anthropic Server-Side Fallback (Fable 5)
ui.description: When a Claude Fable 5 / Mythos 5 request is blocked by Anthropic's safety classifier, retry it on Claude Opus 4.8 server-side (Anthropic `server-side-fallback-2026-06-01` beta). Opt-in — leaving this off preserves the pre-fallback behavior for every request.

ui.label: Steering Mode
ui.description: How to process queued messages while agent is working

ui.label: Follow-Up Mode
ui.description: How to drain follow-up messages after a turn completes

ui.label: Interrupt Mode
ui.description: When steering messages interrupt tool execution

ui.label: Loop Mode
ui.description: What happens between /loop iterations before re-submitting the prompt

ui.label: Double-Escape Action
ui.description: Action when pressing Escape twice with empty editor

ui.label: Session Tree Filter
ui.description: Default filter mode when opening the session tree

ui.label: Autocomplete Items
ui.description: Max visible items in autocomplete dropdown (3-20)

ui.label: Typo Detection (macOS)
ui.description: Mark misspelled prompt words with the active macOS dictionaries

ui.label: Word Autocomplete (macOS)
ui.description: Show macOS dictionary word completions as inline hints accepted with Tab

ui.label: Autocorrect (macOS)
ui.description: Apply confident macOS spelling corrections after completed words

ui.label: Emoji Autocomplete
ui.description: Suggest emojis from `:name:` shortcodes and expand text emoticons like `:D` or `:-)`

ui.label: Large Paste Menu
ui.description: When a paste reaches this many lines, offer a menu to wrap it in a code block, wrap it in XML tags, or save it to a file. 0 disables the menu (large pastes still collapse to a [Paste] marker).

ui.label: Quiet Startup
ui.description: Skip welcome screen and startup status messages

ui.label: Show Startup Splash
ui.description: Show the full animated setup splash on normal interactive startup without rerunning setup. Quiet Startup still suppresses it.

ui.label: Setup Wizard
ui.description: Show newly added onboarding steps once per setup version

ui.label: Check for Updates
ui.description: Check for omp updates on startup

ui.label: Update Channel
ui.description: Update channel used by omp update and the startup update check

ui.label: Marketplace Auto-Update
ui.description: Check for plugin updates on startup

ui.label: Startup Changelog
ui.description: Choose whether update notes start as a summary, full details, or stay hidden

ui.label: Magic Keywords
ui.description: Enable hidden notices for standalone ultrathink, orchestrate, and workflowz keywords

ui.label: Ultrathink Keyword
ui.description: Let standalone ultrathink request maximum automatic thinking and append its hidden notice

ui.label: Orchestrate Keyword
ui.description: Let standalone orchestrate append its hidden multi-agent orchestration notice

ui.label: Workflow Keyword
ui.description: Let standalone workflowz append its hidden eval workflow notice

ui.label: Completion Notification
ui.description: Notify when the agent finishes a turn

ui.label: Error Notification
ui.description: Notify when the agent stops with an error

ui.label: Ask Timeout
ui.description: Auto-select the recommended ask option after this many seconds (0 disables)

ui.label: Ask Notification
ui.description: Notify when the ask tool is waiting for input

ui.label: Idle Recap
ui.description: Generate a brief LLM recap of where things stand after the terminal has been idle

ui.label: Idle Recap Delay
ui.description: Seconds to wait while idle before showing the recap

ui.label: Relay URL
ui.description: Relay used by /collab (wss://host[:port])

ui.label: Web UI URL
ui.description: Browser UI used by /collab links; empty derives from collab.relayUrl; explicit http:// is localhost-only

ui.label: Display Name
ui.description: Name shown to other collab participants (default: OS username)

ui.label: Share Server
ui.description: Share viewer/upload base used by /share (encrypted blob upload + viewer; links are <base>/<id>#<key>)

ui.label: Share Store
ui.description: Where /share uploads the encrypted session blob

ui.label: Share Secret Redaction
ui.description: Run the secret obfuscator over /share snapshots before upload (uses the secrets.* config)

ui.label: Speech-to-Text
ui.description: Enable speech-to-text input via microphone

ui.label: Speech Model
ui.description: Local on-device speech model. Parakeet TDT v3 (sherpa-onnx) is the SoTA default; Whisper base/small/large-v3-turbo tiers (transformers.js) trade size for multilingual coverage. Downloaded on first use.

ui.label: Speech-to-Text Submit Trigger
ui.description: Choose when speech dictation automatically submits: Never, Release (2+ words), Release with complete sentence, or When I Say Submit.

ui.label: Auto-Promote Context
ui.description: Promote to a larger-context model on context overflow instead of compacting

ui.label: Extended Context
ui.description: Use premium long-context windows on models that bill extra past a threshold (e.g. GPT-5.6 1M charges 2x input above 272K); off caps them at the standard-pricing window

ui.label: Auto-Compact
ui.description: Automatically compact context when it gets too large

ui.label: Mid-Turn Compaction
ui.description: Check thresholds at safe mid-turn tool-loop boundaries before the next provider request

ui.label: Compaction Method Order
ui.description: Preferred fallback order for automatic context maintenance; unavailable or failed methods advance to the next choice

ui.label: Compaction Threshold
ui.description: Percent threshold for context maintenance; set to Default to use legacy reserve-based behavior

ui.label: Compaction Token Limit
ui.description: Fixed token limit for context maintenance; overrides percentage if set

ui.label: Save Handoff Docs
ui.description: Save generated handoff documents to markdown files for the auto-handoff flow

ui.label: Remote Compaction V2
ui.description: Use Responses streaming compaction for compatible remote compaction models

ui.label: Async Compaction
ui.description: Speculatively summarize in the background as context nears the compaction threshold, then splice the ready result in when the threshold is crossed

ui.label: Idle Compaction
ui.description: Compact context while idle when token count exceeds threshold

ui.label: Idle Compaction Threshold
ui.description: Token count above which idle compaction triggers

ui.label: Idle Compaction Delay
ui.description: Seconds to wait while idle before compacting

ui.label: Supersede Stale Reads
ui.description: Prune older read results when the same file is read again (cache-aware, runs every turn)

ui.label: Elide Uneventful Results
ui.description: Prune tool results flagged contextually useless (no matches, timed-out waits) once consumed (cache-aware)

ui.label: Snapcompact System Prompt
ui.description: Experimental: render selected system prompt text as dense PNG image(s) and attach to the first user message (vision models only). Saves tokens; loses prompt caching for imaged text.

ui.label: Snapcompact Tool Results
ui.description: Experimental: render large historical tool results as dense PNG image(s) instead of text (vision models only). Saves tokens on accumulated read/search output.

ui.label: Tool Calling Mode
ui.description: Controls how tools are exposed to the model. Auto uses provider-native tool calls unless the selected model is marked as not supporting them, then falls back to the GLM owned dialect. Native forces provider-native tools; the other values force the named owned dialect. Applies on session start.

ui.label: Snapcompact Shape
ui.description: Frame shape snapcompact prints text with (compaction archive and inline imaging). Auto picks a shape tuned for the current model.

ui.label: Branch Summaries
ui.description: Prompt to summarize when leaving a branch

ui.label: Memory Backend
ui.description: Off, local summary pipeline, Mnemopi SQLite, or Hindsight remote memory

ui.label: Auto-Learn (experimental)
ui.description: After the agent stops, nudge it to capture lessons to memory and create/enhance isolated managed skills

ui.label: Auto-run capture at stop
ui.description: When on, auto-run one private capture turn at stop (uses extra tokens). When off, only standing auto-learn guidance remains.

ui.label: Mnemopi DB Path
ui.description: Optional SQLite DB path. Defaults to the agent memories directory.

ui.label: Mnemopi Bank
ui.description: Optional shared bank base name. Per-project modes derive project-local banks from it.

ui.label: Mnemopi Scoping
ui.description: global = one shared bank; per-project = isolated bank per cwd; per-project-tagged = project-local writes plus global recall visibility

ui.label: Embedding variant
ui.description: Local embedding model family. en = stronger English model; multilingual = cross-language model. Changing this rebuilds existing memory embeddings on next start.

ui.label: Mnemopi Auto Recall
ui.description: Recall local memories into the first turn of each session

ui.label: Mnemopi Auto Retain
ui.description: Retain completed conversation turns into local Mnemopi memory

ui.label: Mnemopi Polyphonic Recall
ui.description: Enable 4-voice recall (vector, graph, fact, temporal) fused with reciprocal rank fusion

ui.label: Mnemopi Enhanced Recall
ui.description: Enable the tiered query result cache for repeated and similar recall queries

ui.label: Mnemopi Proactive Linking
ui.description: Ingest new memories into the episodic graph as they are stored, linking them to related entities and memories

ui.label: Mnemopi Disable Embeddings
ui.description: Force deterministic FTS-only recall instead of vector embeddings

ui.label: Mnemopi Embedding Model
ui.description: Advanced: explicit embedding model id that overrides the variant. Leave empty to use mnemopi.embeddingVariant.

ui.label: Mnemopi Embedding API URL
ui.description: Optional OpenAI-compatible embedding endpoint passed to Mnemopi

ui.label: Mnemopi Embedding API Key
ui.description: Optional embedding API key passed to Mnemopi

ui.label: Mnemopi LLM Mode
ui.description: Use no LLM, the online tiny model (the TINY role from /models, else @smol), or a remote OpenAI-compatible endpoint

ui.label: Mnemopi LLM Base URL
ui.description: Optional OpenAI-compatible LLM endpoint for Mnemopi remote mode

ui.label: Mnemopi LLM API Key
ui.description: Optional LLM API key for Mnemopi remote mode

ui.label: Mnemopi LLM Model
ui.description: Optional LLM model name for Mnemopi remote mode

ui.label: Hindsight API URL
ui.description: Hindsight server URL (Cloud or self-hosted)

ui.label: Hindsight API Token
ui.description: Bearer token for authenticated Hindsight servers

ui.label: Hindsight Bank ID
ui.description: Memory bank identifier (default: project name)

ui.label: Hindsight Scoping
ui.description: global = one shared bank; per-project = isolated bank per cwd; per-project-tagged = shared bank with project tags so global + project memories merge on recall

ui.label: Hindsight Auto Recall
ui.description: Recall memories on the first turn of each session

ui.label: Hindsight Auto Retain
ui.description: Retain transcript every N turns and at session boundaries

ui.label: Hindsight Retain Mode
ui.description: full-session = upsert one document per session, last-turn = chunked

ui.label: Hindsight Mental Models
ui.description: Read curated reflect summaries (mental models) into developer instructions at boot. Loads existing models on the bank — does not write. Pair with hindsight.mentalModelAutoSeed to also auto-create the built-in seed set.

ui.label: Hindsight Mental Model Auto-Seed
ui.description: At session start, create any built-in mental models (project-conventions, project-decisions, user-preferences) that do not yet exist on the bank.

ui.label: TTSR
ui.description: Interrupt the agent mid-stream when output matches rule patterns (Time-Traveling Stream Rules)

ui.label: TTSR Context Mode
ui.description: What to do with partial output when TTSR triggers

ui.label: TTSR Interrupt Mode
ui.description: When to interrupt mid-stream vs inject warning after completion

ui.label: TTSR Repeat Mode
ui.description: How rules can repeat: once per session or after a message gap

ui.label: TTSR Repeat Gap
ui.description: Messages before a rule can trigger again

ui.label: Built-in Rules
ui.description: Load the default rules shipped with the agent (override individually with ttsr.disabledRules)

ui.label: Disabled Rules
ui.description: Rule names to ignore entirely (applies to bundled defaults and your own rules)

ui.label: Edit Mode
ui.description: Select the edit tool variant (replace, patch, hashline, or apply_patch)

ui.label: Fuzzy Match
ui.description: Accept high-confidence fuzzy matches for whitespace differences

ui.label: Fuzzy Match Threshold
ui.description: Similarity threshold (0-1) for accepting fuzzy matches

ui.label: Abort on Failed Preview
ui.description: Abort streaming edit tool calls when patch preview fails

ui.label: Block Auto-Generated Files
ui.description: Prevent editing of files that appear to be auto-generated (protoc, sqlc, swagger, etc.)

ui.label: Enforce Seen-Line Guard
ui.description: Reject edits anchored on lines a prior read/search never displayed in full

ui.label: Record Parse Regressions
ui.description: Append full before/after source when an edit introduces an AST parse failure

ui.label: Auto-Repair Parse Regressions
ui.description: When an edit breaks a file's AST parse, ask the smol model to fix the broken region (validated by re-parse; falls back to a warning)

ui.label: Line Numbers
ui.description: Prepend line numbers to read tool output by default

ui.label: Default Read Limit
ui.description: Default number of lines returned when agent calls read without a limit

ui.label: Markdown Previews
ui.description: Render Markdown read results as formatted terminal Markdown previews instead of raw source

ui.label: Read Summaries
ui.description: Return structural code summaries when read is called without an explicit selector

ui.label: Prose Summaries
ui.description: Return structural summaries for Markdown and plain text reads

ui.label: Read Summary Body Lines
ui.description: Minimum multiline body or literal length before read summaries collapse it

ui.label: Read Summary Comment Lines
ui.description: Minimum multiline block comment length before read summaries collapse it

ui.label: Read Summary Minimum File Length
ui.description: Files with fewer total lines are read verbatim instead of structurally summarized

ui.label: Read Summary Unfold Target
ui.description: BFS-unfold elidable spans until the summary is at least this many visible lines. 0 keeps only the outermost elisions.

ui.label: Read Summary Unfold Ceiling
ui.description: Hard ceiling on summary size while BFS-unfolding. An unfold whose revealed lines would exceed this is skipped (that span stays folded) and unfolding continues with the remaining spans.

ui.label: Inline Read Previews
ui.description: Render read tool results inline in the transcript instead of summary rows

ui.label: LSP
ui.description: Enable the lsp tool for code intelligence (definitions, references, diagnostics, rename)

ui.label: Lazy LSP Startup
ui.description: Start language servers on first use (lsp tool or editing a matching file type) instead of at session startup

ui.label: Shared Language Servers
ui.description: Share one language server per project across omp instances via the daemon broker (falls back to private servers when unavailable)

ui.label: Format on Write
ui.description: Automatically format code files using LSP after writing

ui.label: Diagnostics on Write
ui.description: Return LSP diagnostics after writing code files

ui.label: Diagnostics on Edit
ui.description: Return LSP diagnostics after editing code files

ui.label: Deduplicate Diagnostics
ui.description: Suppress post-edit LSP diagnostics already shown for a file; only surface new or changed ones

ui.label: Bash
ui.description: Enable the bash tool for shell command execution

ui.label: Bash Auto-Background
ui.description: Automatically background long-running bash commands and deliver the result later

ui.label: Bash Approval Patterns
ui.description: Ordered bash command approval rules. Each item has match and approval fields; only '*' wildcards are supported.

ui.label: Bash Interceptor
ui.description: Block shell commands that have dedicated tools

default.message: Use the `read` tool instead of cat/head/tail. It provides better context and handles binary files.
Use the `grep` tool instead of grep/rg. It respects .gitignore and provides structured output.
Use the `glob` tool instead of find/fd. It respects .gitignore and is faster for glob patterns.
Use the `edit` tool instead of sed -i. It provides diff preview and fuzzy matching.
Use the `edit` tool instead of perl -i. It provides diff preview and fuzzy matching.
Use the `edit` tool instead of awk -i inplace. It provides diff preview and fuzzy matching.
Use the `write` tool instead of echo/cat redirection. It handles encoding and provides confirmation.
Use the `hub` tool (`op:"start"`) instead of nohup or background shell syntax so the process stays observable and managed.
Use the `hub` tool (`op:"start"`) for services, watchers, and debuggers so other omp instances can observe and control them.
Use the `hub` tool (`op:"start"`) for watch mode so its output, input, and lifecycle stay managed.

ui.label: direnv Auto-Load
ui.description: Auto-load a repo's direnv/devenv `.envrc` into the bash session so devenv tools and env vars are present without manual `direnv exec`. Honors direnv's allow list: an `.envrc` you haven't `direnv allow`ed is never executed

ui.label: direnv Load Timeout (ms)
ui.description: Max wait for the first `direnv export` (a cold devenv shell can be slow); on timeout the session runs without the direnv env

ui.label: Shell Minimizer
ui.description: Compress verbose shell output (git, npm, cargo, etc.) before returning it to the agent

ui.label: Shell Minimizer Source Outline
ui.description: Source outline mode for cat/read of source files: default or aggressive

ui.label: Python Eval Backend
ui.description: Allow the eval tool to dispatch Python cells to the IPython kernel

ui.label: JavaScript Eval Backend
ui.description: Allow the eval tool to dispatch JavaScript cells to the in-process runtime

ui.label: Ruby Eval Backend
ui.description: Allow the eval tool to dispatch Ruby cells to the persistent Ruby kernel

ui.label: Julia Eval Backend
ui.description: Allow the eval tool to dispatch Julia cells to the persistent Julia kernel

ui.label: Eval Auto-Background
ui.description: Automatically background long-running eval cells and deliver the result later

ui.label: Python Kernel Mode
ui.description: Keep the IPython kernel alive across eval calls or start fresh each time

ui.label: Python Interpreter
ui.description: Optional path to an exact Python executable. When set, automatic Python runtime discovery is skipped.

ui.label: Ruby Interpreter
ui.description: Optional path to an exact Ruby executable. When set, automatic Ruby runtime discovery is skipped.

ui.label: Julia Interpreter
ui.description: Optional path to an exact Julia executable. When set, automatic Julia runtime discovery is skipped.

ui.label: Tool Approval Policies
ui.description: Per-tool approval policies. Set to 'allow' to auto-approve, 'prompt' to require confirmation, or 'deny' to block. Overrides are honored in every approval mode.

ui.label: Tool Approval
ui.description: Default approval behavior for tool calls. 'Always ask' auto-approves read-only tools only. 'Write' auto-approves read and workspace-write tools. 'Yolo' auto-approves all tiers; user policy may still prompt or block.

ui.label: Todos
ui.description: Enable the todo tool for task tracking

ui.label: Todo Reminders
ui.description: Remind the agent to complete todos before stopping

ui.label: Todo Reminder Limit
ui.description: Maximum number of todo reminders before giving up

ui.label: Create Todos Automatically
ui.description: How strongly to push automatic todo-list creation after the first message

ui.label: Glob
ui.description: Enable the glob tool for glob-based file lookup

ui.label: Grep
ui.description: Enable the grep tool for regex content search

ui.label: Grep Context Before
ui.description: Lines of context before each grep match

ui.label: Grep Context After
ui.description: Lines of context after each grep match

ui.label: AST Grep
ui.description: Enable the ast_grep tool for structural AST search

ui.label: AST Edit
ui.description: Enable the ast_edit tool for structural AST rewrites

ui.label: Debug
ui.description: Enable the debug tool for DAP-based debugging

ui.label: Launch
ui.description: Enable the launch tool for supervising shared long-running project processes

ui.label: Speech Generation
ui.description: Enable the tts tool for on-device (Kokoro) or xAI Grok Voice speech-file synthesis

ui.label: Generate Image
ui.description: Enable the generate_image tool (text-to-image generation and editing). Exposed as an xd:// device when tools.xdev is on.

ui.label: Inspect Image
ui.description: Controls the inspect_image tool, which delegates image understanding to a vision-capable model. 'auto' exposes it only when the active model lacks native image input; 'on' always exposes it; 'off' never does.

ui.label: Computer
ui.description: Enable the scriptable host-desktop control tool (screenshots, input, accessibility)

ui.label: Computer Display
ui.description: Composite all displays or select a native display id

ui.label: Computer Screenshot Width
ui.description: Maximum composite screenshot width in pixels

ui.label: Computer Screenshot Height
ui.description: Maximum composite screenshot height in pixels

ui.label: Inspect Image Timeout
ui.description: Per-request timeout for the inspect_image vision-model call, in milliseconds. A stalled provider fails fast with a timeout error instead of blocking until manual abort. Set to 0 to disable the timeout.

ui.label: Checkpoint/Rewind
ui.description: Enable the checkpoint and rewind tools for context checkpointing

ui.label: Read URLs
ui.description: Allow the read tool to fetch and process URLs

ui.label: Obsidian Vault
ui.description: Enable the vault:// internal URL for reading and editing Obsidian vault content via the Obsidian CLI. When disabled, vault:// resolution is refused and the vault:// entry is omitted from the system prompt.

ui.label: GitHub CLI
ui.description: Enable the github tool (op-based dispatch for repository, issue, pull request, diff, search, checkout, push, and Actions watch workflows)

ui.label: GitHub View Cache
ui.description: Cache rendered issue/PR view output in ~/.omp/cache/github-cache.db so repeated reads are free

ui.label: GitHub Cache Soft TTL
ui.description: Within this window, cached issue/PR view rows are returned directly (seconds; default 5 minutes)

ui.label: GitHub Cache Hard TTL
ui.description: Past the soft TTL the cached row is returned and refreshed in the background; past the hard TTL it is dropped (seconds; default 7 days)

ui.label: Web Search
ui.description: Enable the web_search tool for live web results

ui.label: Security
ui.description: Enable OMP-native security scan planning, execution, and the read-only security:// resource namespace

ui.label: Ask
ui.description: Enable the ask tool for interactive user questions

ui.label: Browser
ui.description: Enable the browser tool for scripted Chromium automation (puppeteer)

ui.label: Browser CDP URL
ui.description: Default HTTP CDP discovery endpoint (for example http://127.0.0.1:9222) to attach to instead of launching a browser. Explicit app.cdp_url or app.path on the tool call take precedence.

ui.label: Browser Relay
ui.description: Drive your own Chrome tabs through the omp browser relay. Install the extension once (`omp browser-relay install`); the relay server auto-starts when the browser tool needs it. Takes precedence over Browser CDP URL; set PI_BROWSER_RELAY=0 or PI_BROWSER_RELAY=1 to override.

ui.label: Browser Relay URL
ui.description: omp browser relay endpoint (default http://127.0.0.1:9224).

ui.label: Headless Browser
ui.description: Launch browser in headless mode (disable to show browser UI)

ui.label: cmux Browser
ui.description: Use cmux WKWebView surfaces for browser automation when a cmux socket is available. Set PI_BROWSER_CMUX=0 or PI_BROWSER_CMUX=1 to override.

ui.label: Screenshot Directory
ui.description: Directory to save screenshots. If unset, screenshots go to a temp file. Supports ~. Examples: ~/Downloads, ~/Desktop, /sdcard/Download (Android)

ui.label: Intent Tracing
ui.description: Ask the agent to describe the intent of each tool call before executing it

ui.label: Abort On Fabricated Tool Result
ui.description: With in-band tool calls, stop the model immediately when it starts hallucinating a tool result mid-turn. Disable to let the model finish generating and discard the fabricated continuation instead.

ui.label: Max Tool Timeout
ui.description: Maximum timeout in seconds the agent can set for any tool (0 = no limit)

ui.label: Async Execution
ui.description: Enable async bash commands and background task execution

ui.label: Max Poll Time
ui.description: How long a `hub` wait watches background jobs before returning the current state. A fixed value waits that exact duration every time. `smart` adapts: it starts at 5s and lengthens with each back-to-back wait (up to 5m), then resets to 5s after about a minute without waiting.

ui.label: IRC Timeout
ui.description: Default timeout for hub message waits (and send await:true) in milliseconds; 0 disables the timeout

ui.label: xd:// Tools
ui.description: Mount rarely-used (discoverable) tools under xd:// device URLs driven via read/write instead of shipping their schemas on every request. Sessions whose explicit tool list grants read but omits write mount devices through a device-only write transport (filesystem writes stay rejected). Disable to expose every enabled tool top-level.

ui.label: xd:// Prompt Docs
ui.description: Choose which mounted-device docs and schemas are inlined in the system prompt. Built-ins keeps core tools inline while MCP and extension tools stay on-demand.

ui.label: xd:// Inline Devices
ui.description: When xd:// Prompt Docs is Built-ins Only, inline dynamic devices whose names match these glob patterns (for example mcp__context_mode_*). Catalog Only ignores this setting.

ui.label: MCP Project Config
ui.description: Load .mcp.json/mcp.json from project root

ui.label: MCP Markdown Results
ui.description: Render non-JSON MCP text results as Markdown in the transcript

ui.label: MCP Update Injection
ui.description: Inject MCP resource updates into the agent conversation

ui.label: MCP Notification Debounce
ui.description: Debounce window in milliseconds for MCP resource updates before injecting them into the conversation

ui.label: Plan Mode
ui.description: Enable plan mode for read-only exploration and planning before execution

ui.label: Start in Plan Mode
ui.description: Automatically enter plan mode at the start of every new session

ui.label: Goal Mode
ui.description: Enable per-session goal mode and the hidden goal tool

ui.label: Goal Status in Footer
ui.description: Show token budget alongside the goal indicator in the status line

ui.label: Goal Continuation Modes
ui.description: Run modes where active goals may auto-continue between turns

ui.label: Refresh Title on Replan
ui.description: Refresh generated session titles after todo init replans unless the title was set by the user

ui.label: Isolation Mode
ui.description: Isolation backend for subagents. "auto" lets the native PAL pick the best available backend (CoW-aware filesystems, then overlayfs/ProjFS, then a git worktree / recursive-copy fallback).

ui.label: Apply Isolated Changes
ui.description: Automatically apply successful isolated task changes to the parent checkout; disable to retain patch or branch artifacts

ui.label: Isolation Merge Strategy
ui.description: How isolated task changes are integrated (patch apply or branch merge)

ui.label: Isolation Commit Style
ui.description: Commit message style for nested repo changes (generic or AI-generated)

ui.label: Worktree Base Directory
ui.description: Base directory for agent-managed worktrees — task-isolation copies, `github` PR checkouts, and `omp worktree` cleanup all live here. Unset uses ~/.omp/wt. Must be an absolute or ~-relative path; relative paths are ignored. The OMP_WORKTREE_DIR env var overrides this.

ui.label: Prefer Task Delegation
ui.description: How strongly to push delegating work to subagents

ui.label: Batch Task Calls
ui.description: Switch the task tool to its batch shape: one call carries { context, tasks[] } — one subagent per item, with an optional per-item agent (defaulting to the session spawn-policy agent), per-item isolation, and a required shared context prepended to every assignment. With async.enabled=true, each spawn runs as an independent background agent with the normal idle/parked lifecycle; otherwise the call blocks for merged results. Disable to restore the flat single-spawn schema.

ui.label: Per-Task Effort
ui.description: Expose the optional effort parameter on task spawns, allowing callers to override each subagent's thinking level

ui.label: Max Concurrent Tasks
ui.description: Maximum number of subagents running concurrently

ui.label: LSP in Subagents
ui.description: Allow subagents spawned via the task tool to use the lsp tool. Off by default to keep subagents cheap; enable when LSP-aware delegation is worth the extra tokens.

ui.label: Max Task Recursion
ui.description: How many levels deep subagents can spawn their own subagents

ui.label: Max Subagent Runtime
ui.description: Hard wall-clock limit per subagent (ms). 0 disables it. Defense-in-depth against provider-side stream hangs that escape the inference-layer watchdog; triggers a normal subagent abort with a 'timed out' reason.

ui.label: Agent Idle TTL
ui.description: How long an idle subagent stays live in memory before being parked to disk (ms). Parked agents are revived automatically when messaged or resumed. 0 keeps idle agents live until exit.

ui.label: Soft Subagent Request Budget
ui.description: Soft per-subagent request budget (assistant requests per run). Crossing it injects a wrap-up steering notice (see task.softRequestBudgetNotice); at 1.5x the budget the run is force-stopped and the agent must yield its partial findings. 0 disables the guard. Bundled scout/sonic agents cap out at a lower built-in budget, so a value below that cap still applies to them.

ui.label: Soft Request Budget Notice
ui.description: Inject one steering notice when a subagent crosses its soft request budget, asking it to wrap up before the 1.5x forced-yield stop.

ui.label: Maximum Per-Spawn Effort
ui.description: Maximum reasoning effort allowed for the task tool's per-spawn effort hint. Lower values prevent callers from escalating subagents above this ceiling; the default preserves the model's full range.

ui.label: Generic Task Prewalk
ui.description: Arm prewalk for the bundled generic `task` subagent: it starts on its resolved model, plans and begins the implementation, then hands off to the 'smol' role at its first edit/write. Per-agent overrides (task.agentPrewalk, configured from the /agents hub) and user agent `prewalk` frontmatter apply regardless of this toggle.

ui.label: Todo Auto-Clear Delay
ui.description: Delay before completed or abandoned todos are removed from the todo widget

ui.label: Show Resolved Model Badge
ui.description: Display the actual model ID used by each subagent in the task widget status line

ui.label: Skill Commands
ui.description: Register skills as /skill:name commands

ui.label: Claude User Commands
ui.description: Load commands from ~/.claude/commands/

ui.label: Claude Project Commands
ui.description: Load commands from .claude/commands/

ui.label: OpenCode User Commands
ui.description: Load commands from ~/.config/opencode/commands/

ui.label: OpenCode Project Commands
ui.description: Load commands from .opencode/commands/

ui.label: Hide Secrets
ui.description: Obfuscate configured secrets and redact credential-shaped tokens before sending to AI providers

ui.label: Ollama Cloud Max Concurrency
ui.description: Maximum concurrent Ollama Cloud subagent runs per process; 0 disables the provider-specific limit

ui.label: Web Search Provider Order
ui.description: Prioritized providers for the web_search tool; unlisted providers retain their default order afterward

ui.label: Excluded Web Search Providers
ui.description: Providers that web_search should never use, even as fallbacks

ui.label: Web Search Timeout
ui.description: Hard timeout for each provider's search transport before web_search advances to the next fallback, in seconds (maximum 300)

ui.label: Gemini web_search model
ui.description: Model ID for Gemini Google Search grounding. Defaults to gemini-2.5-flash.

ui.label: Antigravity Endpoint Mode
ui.description: Endpoint routing strategy for google-antigravity providers (chat, search, image, discovery)

ui.label: Image Provider Order
ui.description: Prioritized providers for image generation; unlisted providers follow the active session provider and the built-in order

ui.label: Fireworks Tier
ui.description: Serving path for Fireworks requests. Priority sends `service_tier: "priority"` for higher reliability during peak traffic at a higher price; Standard omits it. Fast (`-fast`) models ignore this — Fast is its own serving path.

ui.label: Live Voice
ui.description: Voice used by Codex-backed realtime voice sessions

ui.label: Text-to-Speech Provider
ui.description: Backend for the tts tool: local on-device neural TTS (Kokoro-82M), xAI Grok Voice, or DeepInfra speech

ui.label: Local TTS Model
ui.description: On-device neural TTS model (Kokoro-82M) used by the local TTS backend

ui.label: Local TTS Voice
ui.description: Kokoro voice used by the local TTS backend (American/British, female/male)

ui.label: Speech Vocalization
ui.description: Speak the assistant's output aloud through the speakers as it streams

ui.label: Speech Vocalization Mode
ui.description: What to speak: all = assistant messages + thinking; assistant = messages only; yield = only the final message at turn end

ui.label: Enhanced Speech Rewriting
ui.description: Rewrite assistant output into natural spoken prose with the tiny/smol model before synthesis (describes code, drops links and markdown). Falls back to mechanical cleanup on failure

ui.label: Speech Vocalization Voice
ui.description: Kokoro voice used when speaking the assistant's output aloud

ui.label: Tiny Model
ui.description: Session-title model: online (the TINY role from /models, else @smol) by default, or a local on-device model

ui.label: Tiny Model Device
ui.description: ONNX execution provider for local tiny models (titles + memory). Default uses CPU-only inference. The PI_TINY_DEVICE env var overrides this.

ui.label: Tiny Model Precision
ui.description: ONNX quantization/precision for local tiny models. Default uses each model's shipped dtype (q4); lower precision is faster, higher is more faithful. The PI_TINY_DTYPE env var overrides this.

ui.label: Memory Model
ui.description: Mnemopi LLM for fact extraction + consolidation: online (the TINY role from /models, else smol/remote) by default, or a local on-device model

ui.label: Auto Thinking Model
ui.description: Difficulty classifier for the `auto` thinking level: online (the TINY role from /models, else smol) by default, or a local on-device model

ui.label: Auto Thinking Ceiling
ui.description: Highest effort the `auto` classifier may resolve. `xhigh` keeps the classifier one tier below the top, so only an explicit `ultrathink` reaches `max`; `max` lets a turn the classifier judges exceptional bill the top tier on models that expose it.

ui.label: Unexpected Stops
ui.description: Automatically recover when the assistant stops without a visible message. Smart also classifies text-only stops with a small model.

ui.label: Unexpected Stop Model
ui.description: Classifier for Smart unexpected-stop detection: online (the TINY role from /models, else smol) by default, or a local on-device model.

ui.label: Kimi API Format
ui.description: API format for Kimi Code provider (auto follows live model metadata)

ui.label: OpenAI WebSockets
ui.description: Websocket policy for OpenAI Codex models (auto uses model defaults, on forces, off disables)

ui.label: Prompt Cache Retention
ui.description: Prompt-cache retention forwarded to providers that support it (Anthropic, Bedrock, OpenRouter, OpenAI)

ui.label: Stream First Event Timeout
ui.description: Seconds to wait for the first model stream event; -1 uses provider/env defaults, 0 disables the watchdog

ui.label: Stream Idle Timeout
ui.description: Seconds a model stream may stay silent between events; -1 uses provider/env defaults, 0 disables the watchdog

ui.label: OpenRouter Routing
ui.description: Default routing-variant suffix appended to OpenRouter model IDs (overridden when the selector already names a variant)

ui.label: Fetch Provider
ui.description: Reader backend priority for the fetch/read URL tool

ui.label: Codex Auto-Redeem Saved Resets
ui.description: Spend saved Codex rate-limit resets automatically: restore an account blocked by an exhausted 5h or weekly window when a turn is stuck and no other account can take over, and salvage credits that are about to expire. unset asks before the first spend, yes spends without prompting, and no disables both checks.

ui.label: Codex Auto-Redeem Min Block
ui.description: Only auto-redeem when the natural unblock — the latest reset among the exhausted 5h/weekly windows — is at least this many minutes away (don't spend a scarce credit to save a short wait). Raise it (e.g. 360) to ignore 5h-only blocks.

ui.label: Codex Auto-Redeem Reserve
ui.description: Never auto-spend below this many saved resets (0 = the last credit may be spent automatically). Credits about to expire are exempt — a reserved credit that expires preserves nothing.

ui.label: Codex Reset Salvage Horizon
ui.description: Spend a saved Codex reset automatically when it would otherwise expire within this many hours and either chat window (5h or weekly) has meaningful usage to restore (0 disables expiry salvage).

ui.label: Append-Only Context
ui.description: Cache system prompt + tool specs and keep an append-only message log so provider prefix caches (DeepSeek, Xiaomi/SGLang, Anthropic) hit at maximum rate. Auto enables for known prefix-cache providers.

ui.label: Exa
ui.description: Enable the Exa web search provider

ui.label: Exa Search Delay
ui.description: Minimum delay between Exa web search requests in milliseconds; set 0 to disable pacing

ui.label: SearXNG Endpoint
ui.description: Base URL of a self-hosted SearXNG instance used for web search

ui.label: Tool Call Handler Timeout (ms)
ui.description: Positive finite active-work timeout for extension tool_call handlers; invalid values use 30000ms, and time awaiting OMP-owned dialogs does not count

ui.label: Auto QA
ui.description: Automated tool issue reporting (xd://report_issue). On by default; the first report asks for consent, and denying it disables reporting until re-enabled explicitly

ui.label: Auto QA Push Endpoint
ui.description: Full URL receiving Auto QA JSON reports (default https://qa.omp.sh/v1/grievances)
